data.name: Jacinthe
data.long_meaning: From the Latin name 'Hyacinthus', meaning 'hyacinth flower'. Derived from the Greek name 'Hyakinthos', which may be derived from the word 'hyakinthos' meaning 'a fragrant flower'.
